name: JW Marriott Parq Vancouver
positioning: Luxury hotel on False Creek in Downtown Vancouver's Stadium District, part of Parq Vancouver, with a 17th-floor Spa by JW wellness level and an open-air Aqua Lounge
best_for: Sports and concert fans who want to be steps from BC Place Stadium and Rogers Arena
Wellness-minded city travelers who want a rooftop spa level with views over False Creek

facts.text: The hotel sits in Downtown Vancouver's Stadium District, steps from BC Place Stadium and Rogers Arena.
The hotel sits along False Creek, with Yaletown and Granville Island close by.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city, ocean and mountain views.
Each two-bedroom Sky Suite has a personal media room at the heart of the suite.
The wellness floor includes a 4,240-square-foot fitness studio, steam rooms and a manicure and pedicure bar.
The Organic Honey Detox wellness journey uses raw honey from the hotel's resident JW Garden honeybees.
Guests have access to Parq Vancouver's 72,000-square-foot gaming facility, which includes private salons.
The hotel's accommodations are crafted to LEED Gold certification.
Arriving guests are met with a signature scent and sound from the JW Marriott and Flamingo Estate collaboration.
D/6 Lounge is an indoor/outdoor rooftop bar with views of the city skyline.
Pet-friendly rooms welcome one dog per room, up to 15 kg.

highlights.text: Spa by JW sits on the 17th-floor wellness level, overlooking BC Place and False Creek.
The rooftop Aqua Lounge is an outdoor pavilion with a hydrotherapy tub overlooking BC Place and False Creek.
The two-level Parq Villa has white oak floors and a 600-square-foot terrace with views of the False Creek waterfront.
The spa offers the Mind-Sync Harmonic Sleep Lounger, a zero-gravity chair that uses vibro-acoustic sound wave therapy.
The Victor is a sixth-floor rooftop restaurant featuring Pacific Northwest seafood and specialty steaks.

considerations.text: The Aqua Lounge is not a standard swimming pool.
Conde Nast Traveler says it is not a place for travelers seeking a quiet or low-key experience; the hotel is attached to a casino.
WhataHotel notes the casino environment may not appeal to all guests.
